explanations.beginner: This blueprint sets up a game combat fight. It spawns an enemy with 100 health, deals 35 damage with an attack, checks if the enemy was defeated, and prints the result.
explanations.intermediate: Data flows from enemyInit and attack into game-entity.applyDamage. The remaining health is evaluated by a conditional defeat check, which activates victory reward output when health is at most 0.
explanations.advanced: Composes otter-official/game-entity Actor state and applyDamage pure mutation with otter-official/math-utils. Emits idiomatic relative imports: use ".otter/packages/otter-official/game-entity/src/main.ot".
